summary.text: Sally Hebert is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 94 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Republican Gil Gatch is also on the ballot.
She is a substitute teacher and a former newspaper reporter.

paragraphs.text: Sally Hebert graduated from West Forsyth High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Appalachian State University in 1991.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in a farming community on the outskirts of Winston-Salem, North Carolina, and worked as a newspaper reporter in North Carolina covering business and county government.
She also said she worked for the Dorchester County Council, and that she currently works as a substitute teacher at a local high school.
Hebert advanced from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary for District 94, defeating Collin Holloway and Bryan Sharper.

In her Ballotpedia survey she said she is running to break the Republican supermajority in South Carolina, and listed support for access to abortion care, Medicaid expansion, a bipartisan commission to draw electoral district maps, and a carve-out for schools from tax breaks for industry among her priorities.
